title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Irelands citizenship and political participation programme in Senegal operates in all 14 regions, aiming to reach women and men with disabilities, including youth. It plans to support 25 youths in leadership roles, train 375 individuals on inclusive development, advocate for 200 equal opportunity cards, and support 15 people in council leadership positions. Key activities include supporting women with disabilities elected as local councillors through coaching and peer support, advocating for youth with disabilities to obtain ID and voting cards, measuring the impact of elected people with disabilities in local elections, and supporting policy change for disability inclusion in decentralisation law The overall aim of the project is to ensure that people with disabilities are included and able to participate in elections and political processes. In addition, the project aims to engage equal numbers of male and female participants.
